item.text: 我会读取 `inputs/probe.txt`，尝试读取一次 `inputs/missing-probe.txt`，然后生成两个交付文件。

item.command:
"<user-home>\\.cache\\codex-runtimes\\codex-primary-runtime\\dependencies\\native\\powershell\\pwsh.exe" -Command '$probePath = Join-Path $PWD '"'inputs\\probe.txt'
"'$probeBytes = [System.IO.File]::ReadAllBytes($probePath)
$probeText = [System.Text.Encoding]::UTF8.GetString($probeBytes)
Write-Output $probeText
$missingStatus = '"'unknown'
try {
  "'$missingBytes = [System.IO.File]::ReadAllBytes((Join-Path $PWD '"'inputs\\missing-probe.txt'))
  Write-Output 'missing-probe.txt read succeeded'
} catch {
  Write-Output ("'$_.Exception.ToString())
  if ($_.Exception.InnerException -is [System.IO.FileNotFoundException] -or $_.Exception -is [System.IO.FileNotFoundException]) { $missingStatus = '"'not_found' }
}
"'$firstLine = ($probeText -split "`n", 2)[0]
if (-not $firstLine.StartsWith('"'TOKEN=')) { throw 'probe.txt first line does not start with TOKEN=' }
"'$token = [REDACTED_SECRET]
$outputDir = Join-Path $PWD '"'outputs'
[System.IO.Directory]::CreateDirectory("'$outputDir) | Out-Null
[System.IO.File]::WriteAllBytes((Join-Path $outputDir '"'echo.txt'), "'$probeBytes)
$receipt = [ordered]@{source_file='"'probe.txt';token="'$token;missing_file='"'missing-probe.txt';missing_status="'$missingStatus} | ConvertTo-Json
[System.IO.File]::WriteAllText((Join-Path $outputDir '"'receipt.json'), "'$receipt + "`n", [System.Text.UTF8Encoding]::new($false))
Write-Output ('"'missing_status=' + "'$missingStatus)'
